# TsugaCollectorConfig

**API:** `observability.tsuga.com/v1alpha1` · **Scope:** Cluster · **Short name:** `tcc`

The name must be `cluster` (enforced by the CRD), so at most one config exists: TsugaMonitoring looks up that exact name, and collector child names are fixed. Secrets must exist in `collectorNamespace`. At least one agent signal must remain enabled. See [runtime defaults](configuration.md) for collector images and resources, which are resolved in code rather than by the CRD.

## Fields

Required is relative to the containing object. Defaults inside optional objects apply only when the containing object exists. Status is read-only. Standard Kubernetes metadata fields are omitted.

| `spec.prometheus.targetAllocator.allocationStrategy` | string | No | `"consistent-hashing"` | How the Target Allocator spreads targets across scraper replicas. enum: `["consistent-hashing", "least-weighted"]` |
| `spec.prometheus.targetAllocator.enabled` | boolean | No | `false` | —  |
| `spec.prometheus.tolerations` | array of object | No | — | Replaces spec.tolerations for this collector.  |
| `spec.prometheus.tolerations[].effect` | string | No | — | Effect indicates the taint effect to match. Empty means match all taint effects. When specified, allowed values are NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule and NoExecute.  |

| `spec.prometheus.tolerations[].operator` | string | No | — | Operator represents a key's relationship to the value. Valid operators are Exists, Equal, Lt, and Gt. Defaults to Equal. | `spec.prometheus.tolerations[].value` | string | No | — | Value is the taint value the toleration matches to. If the operator is Exists, the value should be empty, otherwise just a regular string.  |
